thag14.2:1.1: Just as a fine, well-bred bull
thag14.2:1.2:
yoked to a load,
enduring his load,
thag14.2:2.1: so, too, those who are filled with discernment
thag14.2:3.1:
Having fallen in time
under the sway of time,
thag14.2:3.2:
having come under the sway
of becoming & not-,
thag14.2:4.2: cast down by causes of pain,
thag14.2:4.4:
not seeing them
for what they are.
thag14.2:5.1:
While those who, in the midst of
pleasure & pain
thag14.2:5.3:
stand firm
like a boundary pillar,
thag14.2:7.2:
like a water bead
on a lotus.
thag14.2:7.3:
Everywhere
they are happy, the enlightened,
thag14.2:8.1:
No matter what
the unrighteous gain
thag14.2:8.4: than if there were unrighteous gain.
thag14.2:9.1:
No matter what
the status of the unaware
thag14.2:9.2: or the lowliness of those who know,
thag14.2:9.3:
the lowliness of those who know
is better,
thag14.2:9.4:
not the status of those
unaware.
thag14.2:10.1:
No matter what
the praise from fools
thag14.2:10.2: or the censure from those who know,
thag14.2:10.3:
the censure from those who know
is better
thag14.2:10.4:
than if there were praise
from fools.
thag14.2:11.1:
And as for the pleasure
from sensuality
thag14.2:11.3:
the pain from seclusion
is better
thag14.2:11.4:
than if there were pleasure
from sensuality.
thag14.2:12.1: And as for living through unrighteousness
thag14.2:12.4:
than if one were to live
through unrighteousness.
thag14.2:13.2:
whose minds are calmed
from becoming & non-,
thag14.2:13.4:
For them there is nothing
dear or undear.
